evidence_exactly_one_target.name: evidence_exactly_one_target
evidence_exactly_one_target.value:
(
        ("evidence"."decision_id" IS NOT NULL)::int
        + ("evidence"."learning_goal_id" IS NOT NULL)::int
        + ("evidence"."skill_claim_id" IS NOT NULL)::int
      ) = 1

repos_github_fields.name: repos_github_fields
repos_github_fields.value:
"repos"."source" <> 'github' OR (
        "repos"."installation_id" IS NOT NULL
        AND "repos"."github_repo_id" IS NOT NULL
        AND "repos"."owner" IS NOT NULL
        AND "repos"."is_private" IS NOT NULL
      )
